THE KRYVEIL GAME ARCHIVE

Worlds waiting
in the shadows.

Three original horror concepts. Three worlds with secrets worth uncovering. These projects are in development, and this is only the first glimpse into what waits in the dark.

IN DEVELOPMENT

WARD 27

Psychological Horror

An abandoned medical facility hides a disturbing mystery. Every corridor reveals another piece of the truth, but something inside is aware of your presence.

Somewhere inside, something is waiting for you to remember.

IN DEVELOPMENT

THE PLATFORM BELOW

Atmospheric Horror

You arrive at an unmapped train station where the announcements mention places that should not exist. Each arriving train takes you deeper into an unexplained mystery.

How far below the city are you willing to go?

IN DEVELOPMENT

THE OTHER SIDE OF GLASS

Psychological / Supernatural Horror

Your reflection begins behaving differently. At first, the changes are small. Then it starts doing things you have not done.

Whatever is on the other side has learned your face.

These are original concepts in development—not released games. More details, prototypes, and development updates will be shared as the projects progress.
